main_claim: After beating Soriano, Donchenko says he wants Daniel Rodriguez next, ideally on the year's last card or a five-round APEX fight.
note: Backstage quotes ('Please, let me fight just with him') name a wanted opponent, a wish, so no_fact rather than status_update (opponents as options); the decision win and scorecards are retold as the premise of a post-fight interview, so result is no though the account is detailed.

main_claim: Manager Malki Kawa fires back at Ali Abdelaziz's claim that Usman Nurmagomedov would beat Topuria, saying Topuria would beat every fighter Abdelaziz represents.
note: Kawa 'fired back' at a claim aimed at Topuria, so answers_for_him; 'remains the top fighter in the sport' could be read as assesses_him. 'Promised a dominant return' and 'has not announced his next fight' are a wish and a closing line, no fact.

main_claim: Paddy Pimblett says he would love to fight Topuria but nothing has been finalised and no one has spoken to him about it.
note: Pimblett's own story names Topuria as the opponent he wants ('I'd love to smash his head in') with a recap of his loss, injuries and essay, so only_mentioned per the callout rule, though the long Topuria opening could read as one_of_several; 'rumors swirling' has no who, when or where and Pimblett says 'Nothing yet', so no_fact rather than next_fight at rumour. His essay is described, not quoted.

main_claim: In an NV interview Donchenko recalls life in the TUF 33 house and says the conflicts shown were inflated for the cameras.
note: His recollection of the TUF house ('найкращий досвід у моєму житті', staged conflicts) is a reflection on a show a year ago, not a new fact about him, though an editor could call it personal_life; the Sept 5 Soriano fight is a closing 'Зазначимо' line, background, so next fight is no.

main_claim: Manager Malki Kawa, in a video, tells Ali Abdelaziz Topuria would annihilate his whole roster and promises a masterclass on his comeback.
note: Kawa replies to Abdelaziz's boast that Nurmagomedov would beat Topuria, so answers_for_him; 'still the No. 1 fighter in the world' could be assesses_him. 'Taken time off to heal from facial injuries' is the writer's recap, so health is no; the comeback promise is a wish.

main_claim: Content creator MMARC discusses his new UFC history book and credits Topuria's rise for the MMA boom in Spain and for his own career.
note: The interview is about Marc and his book; Topuria is discussed as a cultural figure ('lo que significa Ilia Topuria para este deporte en España', 'sin Ilia... seguiría en la tienda'), which is an appraisal of his importance to the sport rather than of his level or chances, so none_of_these (assesses_him would be the nearest fit). A YouTuber/author is media.

main_claim: Donchenko explains he picked Daniel Rodriguez as his wanted next opponent because he is ranked 15th and the most convenient top-15 matchup.
note: 'Я обрав Родрігеса' is his wish for a fight with no talks reported, so no_fact; an editor could read 'realistic opponent' as status_update (opponent named as an option). The Soriano win and 2026 record are a 'Як Донченко провів 2026 рік' recap, background.

main_claim: Ian Machado Garry calls Khabib Nurmagomedov one of the greatest ever ahead of challenging Islam Makhachev at UFC 330.
note: Topuria appears only in a 'LATEST NEWS' link about his manager; the article's own text is Garry on Khabib, so nobody does anything regarding Topuria (none_of_these) and source is answered for the main content, Garry.

main_claim: Donchenko beat Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision (30:27, 30:27, 29:28) at UFC Fight Night 287 in Paris, his fourth straight UFC win.
note: A short fight report with the scorecards and nobody speaking; the ex-champions boxing line and betting text are page furniture.

main_claim: Former fighter Matt Brown says an immediate Gaethje rematch could ruin Topuria and he needs a confidence-building fight like Moicano first.
note: The main claim is Brown's sincere advice ('needs a confidence-building fight... before facing Gaethje'), steers_him, though 'not sure Ilia comes back the same' is also assesses_him; Jon Anik's line that the UFC 'is exploring a second fight... for 2027' is a sourced rumour with a date used as the premise, which an editor could score as next_fight at rumour instead of background. Brown is a former UFC welterweight, so other_fighter_side, not media; the orbital/nose/foot injuries are recapped.

main_claim: Merab Dvalishvili says Topuria is doing well, staying positive and enjoying life after the Gaethje loss, and will return to take back the belt.
note: 'Il va bien et reste très positif et profite de la vie' is a named fighter stating how Topuria is, which the guide treats as health however brief; an editor could call it too thin and go no_fact (the rest is a prediction that he will beat everyone, which would make the act none_of_these). Dvalishvili is not linked to a fight with him, so other_fighter_side.

main_claim: Dana White says Topuria is ready to fight and the UFC is ready for him, but he is not on the schedule and no opponent (Gaethje rematch or Pimblett) has been decided.
note: 'Topuria's ready to fight... We don't have him on the schedule right now' from the UFC CEO is status_update, official; Gaethje and Pimblett are options with 'rumors swirling' and no who or when, so next fight is no, and the injuries are the writer's recap. His 'we are back!' post is quoted in two words as context, so he_speaks yes but an editor could treat it as a recalled aside.

main_claim: Topuria breaks his near three-month silence with a video letter to his son Hugo about losing to Gaethje and the character it takes to get back up.
note: The whole piece is his quoted message to Hugo ('Hugo, llevo unos días pensando en ti...'), a message to his son, which the guide files as personal_life; an editor could read it as a reflection with no fact. The facial injuries and the loss are the writer's recap; the coach-on-return-date line is an embedded link.

main_claim: Makhachev's coach Javier Mendez rules out a near-term Topuria fight, saying the Gaethje loss means Topuria needs one or two impressive wins first and doubting his body suits welterweight.
note: Mendez judges his standing ('debe conseguir otra victoria... tiene que ser impresionante', 'no creo que su cuerpo se vaya a adaptar'), assesses_him, though the first part could be steers_him; Makhachev shares the piece (one_of_several possible) and the two were only 'muy cerca de cerrar' a fight that never got booked, so other_fighter_side rather than opponent_side. Topuria's own claims about the failed negotiation are paraphrased, not quoted.

main_claim: Yahoo's post-UFC 330 power rankings place Topuria fifth after his loss to Gaethje, with Makhachev first.
note: One ranking slot among ten retelling his June loss ('slipped to fifth... after losing badly'), so only_mentioned; the writer's placing him fifth and 'god-like complex' remark is an assessment, though an editor could say a list entry is none_of_these. The X status change to 18-0 is an aside, not the article's news.
